August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 154)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American and British networks, Gene Autry and Pat Buttram defending a silver mine on Gene Autry's Melody Ranch for Doublemint Gum, Joe Kelly and 9-year-old math prodigy Joel Kupperman on two Quiz Kids broadcasts for Alka-Seltzer, James Bolam and Rodney Bewes in the football blackout masterpiece No Hiding Place on BBC's Whatever Happened to the Likely Lads?, Hopalong Cassidy comic readings on Comic Weekly Man, and John Storm exploring Tahiti on Ports of Call (1936–1975):
